artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Michael Behaim
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms. The image features a prominent shield in the center depicting a wavy line flanked by intricate floral patterns. Above the shield rests a knight's helmet, adorned with detailed engravings. Atop the helmet, an eagle spreads its wings. Surrounding the central elements are elaborate scrollwork and acanthus leaves. The artwork is framed by simple, clean lines.

artworks.title: The School Teacher
artworks.medium: woodcut and letterpress text on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
block: 12.7 × 9.8 cm (5 × 3 7/8 in.)
sheet (with image and letterpress text): 22.5 × 17.5 cm (8 7/8 × 6 7/8 in.)
sheet (with letterpress text): 23.5 × 17.4 cm (9 1/4 × 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathering in a landscape setting with a text in an illustrative woodcut style. The left side of the page features an intricate black and white illustration of an outdoor scene with a robed figure seated on a stone wall, gesturing towards two other figures who are seated and listening intently. A tree and a hillside complete the background. On the right side, there is a block of printed text in a structured format with clear, bold lettering that appears to convey a continuous narrative or reflections.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Mary and Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image shows a central figure on a cross with other figures on the left and right. The central figure has a serene expression despite being nailed to the cross. The figures on each side appear to be mourning or contemplating, wearing robes and showing detailed facial expressions. There is an inscription above the central figure's head and a skull and bones at the base of the cross. The background includes stylized trees and foliage. This historical illustration captures a religious narrative through intricate line work and contrast.

artworks.title: Death and the Lansquenet
artworks.description: This print depicts two figures. On the left is a skeletal figure holding an hourglass, facing the right. The skeleton is draped in ragged cloth and has wispy hair on its head. On the right is a guard or soldier with a sword at his side and detailed clothing, including a doublet, boots, and a feathered hat, holding a polearm. He is looking towards the hourglass the skeleton holds out towards him. In the background appears to be a tall wall under a blank sky, and the ground appears to be dirt or rocks. Above the figures, "1510" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Death and the Lansquenet
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing and facing each other. The figure on the left is a skeletal figure, dressed in a tattered garment and holding an hourglass. The figure on the right has a realistic appearance with curly hair, wearing an intricately designed costume and holding a staff. They are standing indoors on a wood-textured floor with scattered bones, with a simple architectural structure in the background. Above the figures, there is stylized script along with the year 1510 printed below it.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Mocked by a Soldier
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. The person on the right is seated from the upper body to the knees, with hands clasped in front of their chest. They have a muscular build, a prominent nose, full beard, curly hair, and wear a crown of thorns. They are draped with a cloth around their waist and thighs. The person on the left is depicted from the waist up, kneeling. They have a short, full beard, curly hair, and wear a garment with padded sleeves. They hold a slender staff in their right hand. The background has bold linear engravings indicating clouds at the bottom and expressive lines around the figures.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men gathered around a table. Most men are seated, while a couple are standing. They have various expressions and are engaged in discussion. One central figure has long hair and a beard, emitting light from behind his head. The men have different hairstyles and wear long tunics or robes. Some interact with objects like a jug and plates of food. The background features a detailed domed ceiling with arches and windows.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows four people in historical attire situated in rocky terrain with foliage. In the foreground, one man kneels with his eyes facing upwards, while an angel with wings and a chalice leans over a rocky outcrop. Two other men are depicted: one sitting against a rock with his head on his hand and the other lying on the ground with curly hair spread around him. In the background is a group of people near water, under a cloudy sky. The landscape includes hills and a structure resembling a bridge or scaffolding.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing shows a group of armored soldiers fighting in a chaotic skirmish. A bound figure with a distressed expression is central, surrounded by soldiers wearing various medieval helmets and wielding weapons like swords and spears. The scene is detailed, with expressions of struggle and determination. In the background, there are trees and a tranquil landscape that contrasts with the tumultuous foreground. The drawing is highly detailed with intricate line work and cross-hatching, reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer's style.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: The image shows a man tied to a column with his hands above his head. He is surrounded by a group of people of various appearances, dress, and poses. The central male figure features detailed facial characteristics, curly hair, and is semi-clothed. The background consists of architectural elements like columns, archways, and curtains, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central figure standing in a doorway. The scene is intricately detailed, showcasing a range of expressions and gestures among the figures. The central figure appears to be slightly elevated above the crowd, draped in a robe, and is being presented to the assembled group. The surrounding architecture is quite ornate, with carved details and a sense of classical structure. The people gathered in the foreground appear to be engaged in animated discussion or commentary, with varied poses suggesting a mix of curiosity and debate. The drawing uses strong contrasts and detailed linework to convey texture and depth, characteristic of woodcut techniques. The composition and the historical style of the depictions impart a sense of grandeur and drama.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crowded scene with multiple figures, an architectural backdrop, and a landscape. The image is in black and white, possibly a woodcut or engraving, showing figures in different costumes and actions. The central figures are connected through expressions and gestures. A large, arched gateway is on the left, leading to a fortified structure, with other towers in the background. The composition features detailed costumes and intricate details, including headgear and armor. The scene is rich in movement and narrative, with flora in the foreground and a small animal, possibly a dog. This style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with surrounding figures and celestial imagery. The composition depicts a central figure on a cross, flanked by angelic beings holding cups. Below, several figures are gathered, adorned in garments. In the background, there are celestial elements like the sun and the moon. The landscape includes a bridge and distant structures. This work captures the moment depicted with intricate detailing and symbolic elements.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered closely around a reclining figure, who is a bearded man lying down with his body mostly exposed. The central figure is surrounded by others who are standing or kneeling, dressed in historical or biblical attire. The scene is set in a detailed natural landscape with trees, rocky outcrops, a path through hills, and a small settlement in the distance.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.description: The image is a black and white woodcut print showing a group of people surrounding the body of a man. The man is supported by the others and is mostly unclothed. The figures around him have detailed facial expressions and wear various garments, such as long flowing clothes, head coverings, and veils. Some individuals have facial hair, while others wear elaborate headscarves. One figure holds a decorative jug. In the background, there is a hill with a cross and a figure nailed to it. The landscape includes hills, trees, and mountain peaks under a shaded sky.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.description: This is a print featuring various humans and demonic creatures. In the center, a bearded man with pale skin kneels, his head surrounded by rays of light. His chest is mostly bare, and a long cloth is draped across one of his shoulders and around his waist. He is reaching down towards people in the bottom right corner who appear to be on a lower level, trapped behind an arched opening in a stone wall. The people look up at him, raising their hands toward him, and he grabs one of their arms. Higher up on the right side, demonic creatures look out of openings in the stone wall at the man below. They have horns, snouts, and wings, each creature slightly different. One of them extends a long spear towards the central man. Behind him, on the left, is a procession of several nude people, including men, women, and children. At the front of the procession, an old man holds up a tall cross, and a long banner extends up behind the central man. The scene appears to take place in a stone cave with an arched opening on the left. In the bottom left corner, a hinged wooden door lays broken.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure rising amidst a group of sleeping soldiers. The drawing depicts an illuminated, majestic figure at the center, draped in flowing garments and holding a staff with a banner. This figure stands on a platform or stone slab that has cracked open, surrounded by rays of light. Around the central figure are several armored soldiers resting in various positions. Detailed embellishments and broad strokes highlight the texture of their armor and the folds of their garments. The scene includes clouds and cherubic figures above. Detailed shading and intricate linework define the texture and depth of the entire image.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a battle scene featuring a dense and chaotic array of soldiers and weapons. The detailed drawing depicts numerous figures wearing various armor types and wielding weapons such as spears and swords. They are engaged in intense action against a forest backdrop. Additionally, a large, gnarled tree is visible in the upper right corner, adding a twisted natural element. The composition conveys depth and turmoil through the overlapping figures and dynamic postures. The style is reminiscent of the intricate compositions found in the work of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures interacting in an architectural setting. The central figure is bent over, reaching a hand towards another figure. Beside them are various muscular figures, including nude forms and possible winged creatures, under a large arch. Above them are fantastical beings with sharp features. The style features detailed etching and shading, creating high contrast for depth and intensity. The drawing is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Madonna on the Crescent
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding an infant. She is seated with her legs bent, cradling the child in her arms. The woman's facial expression is calm, with her eyes gazing downward at the child. Her hair is partly covered by a headdress or veil. She wears a long, flowing dress with intricate details. A halo of stars encircles her head, and she sits on a crescent moon. The background displays radiating lines of light and small stars.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a print of an interior scene with people gathered around a bed. At the center of the image, a person with long hair rests on the canopy bed, their body covered in fabric. Gathered around the bed are several people kneeling or standing, almost all facing the bed. Some others speak together or pray. On person holds up a tall, thin cross. The room is detailed, with architectural elements such as arches, a low staircase, and a high domed ceiling.

artworks.title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The full-description shows a heavenly depiction with a crowned female figure seated on a cloud, surrounded by two crowned figures holding a crown above her head. A dove is positioned above them, radiating light. The figures are encased within an elaborate border of clouds, flanked by cherub faces. Beneath this heavenly scene, a group of robed figures are engaging in various gestures, some in prayer and others holding religious artifacts, standing around what seems to be a sarcophagus or altar below. The artwork's line work and detailing are characteristic of woodcut or engraving styles common in religious artworks, reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer's style.

artworks.title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image is a detailed woodcut or engraving showing a scene with multiple figures. The upper portion of the image features a group consisting of three central figures seated on a cloud. The central figure, a female, is sitting with her eyes closed, head tilted slightly downward, hands clasped in her lap, and wearing flowing garments with a veil over her long hair. On her left, a bearded male figure is holding a staff or scepter in his left hand, while on her right, another bearded man is holding a large book. Both men gaze at the female figure, lifting a crown between them. Above the group, a dove is depicted with wide-spread wings, emitting rays of light. Below this celestial scene, on the ground in the foreground, stand several robed figures gazing upward. Two men, both bald and with beards, appear to be holding open books. The space around these people is filled with clouds and vegetation. The background features detailed trees and bushes. The lower foreground shows an empty stone tomb with an open lid. The figures are dressed in intricately patterned, voluminous robes.
